operations.description: XRD patterns were collected on a Bruker-Nonius D8 Advance θ–2θ powder diffractometer with Cu Kα radiation (λ = 1.54 Å), a Bruker Sol-X Si(Li) solid-state detector, and a rotating stage. Samples were drop-cast onto quartz (0001). The source prints a scan duration of 7–15 h, 0.02° angle increment, and 12°/min scan rate; these printed settings are preserved without reconciliation.
